item.title: Higgsfield AI Launches $1 Million Global Film Festival With Open-Sourced Prompts
item.summary: Higgsfield AI has launched a $1,000,000 global AI film festival with 14 winners, an Oscar-affiliated jury, and a commitment to open-source all prompts from its flagship AI films — an announcement amplified by AI marketing builder Shann³ (@shannholmberg).
